chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: The peak period of the band
summary: Asked directly, Greene says he loved playing behind Lester and that the early years were the greatest.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

That's the kind of music I'm thinking of. They were small band records --

Mm hmm.
